data:
## Friday, November 20

### Anadolu Efes Istanbul vs. LDLC ASVEL Villeurbanne (18:30 CET)

##### Efes

Bruno Fernando, Mike James and Isaia Cordinier are ruled out for Efes's game against ASVEL on Friday, the club has confirmed.

- [Bruno Fernando is out for 3-4 weeks](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/efess-bruno-fernando-to-miss-3-4-weeks-with-calf-injury/) after a calf injury sustained in Round 11.
- Erkan Yilmaz last played in Round 10. 
- [Mike James suffered an Achilles injury in Round 3](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/mike-james-achilles-surgery-anadolu-efes/) that will see him sidelined for 7-9 months.
- Isaia Cordinier remains sidelined after undergoing surgery in May, as [was announced on May 18](https://x.com/AnadoluEfesSK/status/2056451478508712239).

##### ASVEL

ASVEL has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Efes on Friday.

- Patty Mills was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Jae Crowder was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Joel Bolomboy suffered a broken nose in Round 11 and then missed Round 12.
- Myles Cale last played in Round 7.
- Yves Pons last played in Round 10.

### Olympiacos Piraeus vs. Real Madrid (20:15 CET)

##### Olympiacos

Nikola Milutinov is a game-time decision while Tyler Dorsey will not play and Jean Montero remains sidelined for Olympiacos's game against Real Madrid on Friday, the club has confirmed.

- [John Konchar left Olympiacos](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/john-konchar-leaves-olympiacos/) on November 16.
- Nikola Milutinov was ruled out for Round 12 and will be evaluated on game day.
- Tyler Dorsey last played in Round 5 after being suspended by the club.
- Jean Montero last played in Round 6. He is ruled out for six months after knee surgery, [the club announced on October 30](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/jean-montero-knee-surgery-olympiacos/).

##### Real Madrid

Real Madrid has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Olympiacos on Friday.

- Theo Maledon returned to action in Round 12.
- Eli Ndiaye, who returned to the club after spending the first part of the season out on loan, has been registered and could make his second Real Madrid debut in Round 13.
- [Mikael Jantunen ruptured his plantar fascia](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/theo-maledon-mikael-jantunen-injuries-real-madrid/) in Round 9 and has been out ever since.
- [Facundo Campazzo is dealing with a hamstring injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/real-madrids-medical-misery-mounts-as-facundo-campazzo-goes-down/). He last played in Round 9.
- Gaby Deck (shoulder) last played in Round 3, with coach Pedro Martinez saying ahead of Round 4: "The injury is more serious than we thought." 
- [Usman Garuba suffered an Achilles injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/usman-garuba-to-undergo-surgery-after-season-ending-achilles-tear/) at last May's Final Four.

### FC Barcelona vs. Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade (20:30 CET)

##### Barcelona

Barcelona has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Crvena Zvezda on Friday.

- [New signing Killian Hayes](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/killian-hayes-signing-barcelona/) has been registered and could make his debut in Round 13.
- Umoja Gibson suffered an injury in Round 11 and is out for three weeks, [Barcelona announced on November 15](https://x.com/FCBbasket/status/2121985074568519821).
- [Kevin Punter](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/barcelona-battered-by-injuries-to-kevin-punter-tosan-evbuomwan/) has suffered a sprain to his left ankle and is expected to be out until the end of December.
- [Tosan Evbuomwan](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/barcelona-battered-by-injuries-to-kevin-punter-tosan-evbuomwan/) has a tear in the oblique muscle of his abdominal wall and is expected to be out until early December.
- Yoan Makoundou has not played so far this season as he recovers from a knee injury.

##### Crvena Zvezda

Crvena Zvezda has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Barcelona on Friday.

- Jared Butler was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Chima Moneke was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Johnathan Motley missed Rounds 11 and 12 due to flu.
- [Stefan Miljenovic](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/zvezdas-stefan-miljenovic-out-after-ankle-surgery/) had ankle surgery before Round 11. He was also ruled out for Round 12.

### Partizan Mozzart Bet Belgrade vs. Besiktas Istanbul (20:45 CET)

##### Partizan

Kevarrius Hayes is a game-time decision while Ethan Thompson and Derek Willis are ruled out for Partizan's game against Besiktas on Friday, the club has confirmed. 

- [New signing Chris Silva](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/partizan-signs-chris-silva-fenerbahce/) made his debut in Round 12.
- Ethan Thompson is out with a hip issue.
- Derek Willis has been sidelined with an [ankle injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/derek-willis-injury-further-depletes-partizan-frontcourt/) he suffered in Round 1.
- Kevarrius Hayes last played in Round 9 due to a shoulder injury and will be a game-day decision.
- Kyle Allman last played in Round 8. He missed Round 11 due to illness. He made the gameday roster in Round 12 but did not step onto the floor.

##### Besiktas

Jaylen Nowell is Besiktas's only absentee for its game at Partizan on Friday, the club has confirmed.

- Jaylen Nowell was ruled out for Rounds 11 and 12.
- Berk Ugurlu last played in Round 9. He was listed as available for Round 12 but didn't make the gameday roster.
## Thursday, November 19

### Maccabi Rapyd Tel Aviv vs. Dubai Basketball (18:15 CET)

##### Maccabi

Maccabi has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Dubai on Thursday.

- Will Rayman was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Iffe Lundberg will be out until December with a [partial tear of his quadriceps](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/maccabi-to-be-without-lundberg-for-6-8-weeks/).

##### Dubai

Dubai has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Maccabi on Thursday.

- Thomas Walkup returned to action in Round 12.
- Davis Bertans last played in Round 9.
- Davion Mintz was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Justin Anderson made his season debut in the ABA League last week but did not play in Round 11. He then didn't feature in the domestic league this past weekend or in Round 12.

### Zalgiris Kaunas vs. Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens (19:00 CET)

##### Zalgiris

Zalgiris has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Panathinaikos on Thursday.

- Nigel Williams-Goss last played in Round 6. He is dealing with a hamstring injury.
- Maodo Lo last played in Round 8. He was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Deividas Sirvydis last played in Round 6.
- Marek Blazevic last played in Round 7.

##### Panathinaikos

Lefteris Mantzoukas is Panathinaikos's only absentee for its game at Zalgiris on Thursday, the club has confirmed.

- Lefteris Mantzoukas has been ruled out for the last two rounds. He last played in Round 6.
- Jerian Grant was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Moustapha Fall was not on the gameday roster in Round 12. He last stepped onto the floor in Round 9.
- Dimitris Moraitis last played in Round 6.

### FC Bayern Munich vs. Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz (20:00 CET)

##### Bayern

Bayern has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Baskonia on Thursday.

- Austin Wiley was a game-time decision for Round 12 and while he was named on the gameday roster, he did not play.
- Vladimir Lucic was ruled out for Round 12.
- Justus Hollatz was ruled out for Round 12.
- [Kamar Baldwin left the club to join Maccabi](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/maccabi-signs-kamar-baldwin-bayern-munich/) on November 10.

##### Baskonia

Baskonia has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Bayern on Tuesday.

- New signing Rolands Smits made his debut in Round 12. He is ruled out for Round 13 due to a virus, [the club announced on Thursday](https://x.com/Baskonia/status/2123360273301897298).
- New signing Kenan Kamenjas made his debut in Round 12.
- [Kenneth Faried suffered a left thigh injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/kenneth-faried-adds-to-baskonia-injury-problems/) in Round 11.
- Marcio Santos last played in Round 9.
- Tadas Sedekerskis last played in Round 7.

### Armani Olimpia Milan vs. Fenerbahce Tarfin Istanbul (20:30 CET)

##### Milan

Devin Booker is Milan's only absentee for its game against Fenerbahce on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Devin Booker suffered a torn tendon in his right thigh in Round 9 and has been out ever since.

##### Fenerbahce

Fenerbahce has confirmed that Nicolo Melli, Braxton Key and Onuralp Bitim will be out.

- [Nicolo Melli underwent surgery on his left knee](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/nicolo-melli-braxton-key-surgery-fenerbahce/) to repair a torn meniscus ahead of Round 12.
- [Braxton Key had an operation on a fractured finger](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/nicolo-melli-braxton-key-surgery-fenerbahce/) on his right hand ahead of Round 12.
- Onuralp Bitim was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- [Chris Silva left the club to join Partizan](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/partizan-signs-chris-silva-fenerbahce/) on November 13.

### Paris Basketball vs. Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv (20:45 CET)

##### Paris

Paris has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Hapoel on Thursday.

- Leo Cavaliere missed his first game of the season in Round 12.
- Joel Ayayi last played in Round 10.
- Daulton Hommes last played in Round 8, but he has played in Paris's last two French League games.

##### Hapoel

Bruno Caboclo is Hapoel's only absentee for its game at Paris on Thursday, the club has confirmed.

- Bruno Caboclo last played in Round 10 and was not on the gameday roster in Round 11. He was ruled out in Round 12.
- Eugene German was on the gameday roster in Round 12 but did not step onto the floor.
- Khadeen Carrington last played in Round 8.
- Bar Timor and Tamir Blatt have not played in the EuroLeague this season.

### Valencia Basket vs. Virtus Bologna (21:00 CET)

##### Valencia

Valencia has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Virtus on Thursday.

- Nate Reuvers (foot) last played in Round 7.
- Nikola Mirotic last played in Round 8 due to injury.
- Yankuba Sima has not played in the EuroLeague this season.

##### Virtus

Davide Casarin is Virtus's only absentee for its game at Valencia on Thursday, the club has confirmed.

- Bobi Klintman was not on the gameday roster in Round 12.
- Davide Casarin has been ruled out since Round 11.
